Categories.Title: Innovation Champion
Categories.Description: Recognizes creative ideas that deliver meaningful improvements.

Questions.Title: Originality of the idea
Questions.QuestionText: Explain what made the idea distinctive and how it addressed an unmet need.

Questions.Title: Implementation and ownership
Questions.QuestionText: Describe how the nominee took the idea from concept to practical delivery.

Questions.Title: Measurable impact
Questions.QuestionText: Share the outcomes, improvements, or value that resulted from the idea.

Categories.Title: Customer Impact
Categories.Description: Recognizes exceptional service and measurable customer outcomes.

Questions.Title: Understanding customer needs
Questions.QuestionText: Show how the nominee identified and understood the customer’s priorities.

Questions.Title: Quality of service or solution
Questions.QuestionText: Describe the exceptional quality of the service or solution provided.

Questions.Title: Measurable customer outcomes
Questions.QuestionText: Share specific results, feedback, or improvements for the customer.

Questions.Title: Sustained customer commitment
Questions.QuestionText: Explain how the nominee maintained a lasting focus on customer success.

Categories.Title: Excellence in Execution
Categories.Description: Recognizes consistently outstanding delivery and ownership.

Questions.Title: Quality and reliability
Questions.QuestionText: Describe how the nominee consistently delivered high-quality, dependable work.

Questions.Title: Ownership and accountability
Questions.QuestionText: Show how the nominee took responsibility and followed through on commitments.

Questions.Title: Results delivered
Questions.QuestionText: Share the outcomes achieved and why they mattered to the organization.

Categories.Title: Collaboration Excellence
Categories.Description: Recognizes teams that succeed through strong cross-functional partnership.

Questions.Title: Cross-functional collaboration
Questions.QuestionText: Describe how the team partnered effectively across functions or boundaries.

Questions.Title: Inclusive participation and knowledge sharing
Questions.QuestionText: Show how the team welcomed diverse perspectives and shared expertise.

Questions.Title: Collective outcomes
Questions.QuestionText: Share the results the team achieved by working together.

Categories.Title: Business Impact
Categories.Description: Recognizes teams that deliver measurable organizational value.

Questions.Title: Alignment with business priorities
Questions.QuestionText: Explain how the team’s work supported strategic organizational priorities.

Questions.Title: Measurable results
Questions.QuestionText: Share specific business outcomes and the evidence used to measure them.

Questions.Title: Effective use of resources
Questions.QuestionText: Describe how the team used time, budget, and expertise responsibly.

Questions.Title: Sustainability of impact
Questions.QuestionText: Explain how the team’s results will continue to create value over time.

Categories.Title: Transformation & Innovation
Categories.Description: Recognizes teams that introduce and sustain meaningful change.

Questions.Title: Novel approach
Questions.QuestionText: Describe the new approach and what made it different from previous practice.

Questions.Title: Adoption and change management
Questions.QuestionText: Explain how the team helped people adopt and sustain the change.

Questions.Title: Measurable improvement
Questions.QuestionText: Share the improvements achieved and how they were measured.

Questions.Title: Scalability and sustainability
Questions.QuestionText: Show how the solution can grow and remain effective over time.
